title: Machine learning-based prediction of lymph node metastasis in papillary thyroid carcinoma: an interpretable multidimensional model.
summary: Interpretable machine learning using multidimensional clinical features predicted lymph-node metastasis in papillary thyroid carcinoma; the Results report validation in a retrospective cohort.
ai_technology: An interpretable machine-learning model used multidimensional clinical features to predict lymph-node metastasis in papillary thyroid carcinoma.
organization: Department of Pathology, Tongling People’s Hospital, China; Department of Pathology, Heping Hospital Affiliated to Changzhi Medical College, China

evidence.tested: Interpretable machine learning using multidimensional clinical features predicted lymph-node metastasis in papillary thyroid carcinoma; the Results report validation in a retrospective cohort. Evaluation: Reported comparison, experimental confirmation or held-out evaluation was checked; reason limits interpretation to the evidence.
evidence.unknown: The result is based on retrospective cohort validation; prospective clinical utility and independent external validation are not established.
evidence.ai_role: An interpretable machine-learning model used multidimensional clinical features to predict lymph-node metastasis in papillary thyroid carcinoma.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
